This beans plot is small and rented, so I will keep my costs low and use what I can manage with my family. I do not usually put chemical fertilizer on beans, and buying it is difficult for me, so I will plant local seed and use some manure if I can get it. I will weed by hand, not irrigate, and I will not use pesticide because it is costly and not common for food crops here.
